pill.desc: lyophilized powder in a single-dose clear glass vial

tell: A polyclonal preparation that depletes T cells within a day, and anti-rabbit antibodies develop in 68% of treated patients.

clues.text: Given only as an intravenous infusion.
An animal-derived polyclonal preparation supplied as a sterile lyophilized powder for reconstitution in water.
Licensed under a BLA as 25 mg single-dose vials, with one dose given on each of several subsequent days.
Contraindicated after allergy to animal proteins or excipients, or with active infections. Urinary tract infection and abdominal pain are the most common reactions.
Prophylaxis and treatment of acute rejection in adult and pediatric patients receiving kidney transplants.
Includes polyclonal antibodies against T-cell markers such as CD2, CD3, CD4 and CD8, which clear T cells from the circulation and modulate their activation.
The generic name begins with A and has three words and twenty-one letters.
